summary: Re-tested account lockout, admin login/logout, credentialed CORS, public empty menu, and unauthenticated mutation. Application auth and lockout pass locally and through external ingress; external credentialed OPTIONS still returns 400 without an explicit origin.

minor.issue: Credentialed preflight returns HTTP 400 and omits Access-Control-Allow-Origin, while local preflight returns 200 with the explicit origin and credentials headers.

action_items: Update the external preview ingress CORS/preflight policy to allow the configured preview origin explicitly with credentials; do not rewrite it to wildcard origin.
critical_code_review_comments: The backend middleware supplies correct explicit credentialed CORS locally, but the deployed edge still rejects OPTIONS before the application response; deployment ingress configuration is part of the auth integration contract.

success_rate.backend: 100% requested application flows; external CORS preflight remains failing

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. CRUD regression used temporary TEST_ records and cleaned them; invalid-login probes used non-existent emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Local and external same-email six-failure probes return 429. Valid admin login sets HttpOnly Secure SameSite=None cookie; /auth/me and logout work; bcrypt hash starts with $2b$. Public home shows empty-menu state and gallery lightbox opens/closes. Re-test external OPTIONS after ingress changes.
rca of the issue: The application middleware handles allowed origins explicitly, but the external preview proxy responds to credentialed OPTIONS with a Starlette/edge-style 400 and no allow-origin header. This is outside the application process and prevents browser cross-origin credentialed preflight; configure the edge to pass OPTIONS and preserve explicit origin/credentials headers.
